corporate_actions.subject: Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 10/- Per Share To Rs 2/- Per Share

penalties.authority: National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE)
penalties.details: NSE imposed a monetary penalty on the Company for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015. The fine was levied at ₹5,000 per day for 15 days, aggregating to ₹75,000 plus GST .
penalties.impact: The financial impact on the Company is to the extent of the fine levied. There is no impact on operation or other activities of the company due to such National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) action.
